name: Fruit Clicker 🍎
desc:
🌱 Fruit Clicker 🍎 is a relaxing incremental idle clicker! 🌱

❓ How to play the game?
🍎 Click to gain Sheckles!
🔨 Upgrade to earn more Sheckles!
🌳 Collect even more Sheckles every second!
🥇 Become the richest Gardener on the Leaderboard!

💜 Thanks for playing!

The game uses fruit icons from the game Grow a Garden (Roblox open assets).
